title: Closeness to a property
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a set with decidable equality, let $f:\Omega\to\beta$, and let $P$ be a property of functions from $\Omega$ to $\beta$. The function $f$ is close to $P$ at tolerance $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$ if there exists a function $g:\Omega\to\beta$ satisfying $P$ whose relative Hamming distance from $f$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
